debug.description: Which debug files the agent writes (see docs/DEBUG-EXCHANGE.md). Each flag: off | errors | full (true = full, false = skip). all_off = true silences all.

budget.description: Token budget. weekly_used_pct is OWNER-ONLY data (null = unknown): the kit never writes it. The three *_pct thresholds say at which weekly_used_pct the governor warns, throttles (free tiers only) and blocks paid work. release_token_budget = tokens one release may spend (0 = no limit).

agents.description: Agent limits. max_parallel = agents the relay planner runs at once (1-6, default 3). tier_by_task_kind = model tier per kind of task (T0 free local, T1 free cloud, T2 cheap paid, T3 strong paid). lab_permission_block = true keeps the Lab permission block (T-085) on.
